message: 不合理な理由
A noise?
It stopped.
Right in front of my room.
They're hesitating.

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet someone's sneaking into your bed.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gufu.」

name: Synn
message: 「Going for a walk, right? Hang on a second.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Azel? You went completely pale earlier today.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm fine. Never mind me, worry about yourself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but you're kind of reckless, Azel, so I can't just leave you alone.」
All of a sudden, Azel stopped in her tracks.

name: Azel
message: 「Is that the only reason you're keeping me company like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Well? Is it?」
Every time a shooting star sparkled, the expression illuminated on her face looked somehow dissatisfied.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you might be targeted by a Demon, Azel, and...」
I saw disappointment surface in her eyes.
She wanted something from me.
And there was something I still hadn't put into words either.

name: Synn
message: 「I... I want to go on walks with you like this, Azel.」
Once I actually said it out loud, it felt surprisingly simple.

name: Azel
message: 「...I see.」
Azel turned her back to me and started walking again.

name: Azel
message: 「That's a rather irrational reason.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so.」

name: Azel
message: 「Still, it's fine... I'm irrational too, anyway.」
Catching up and walking side by side.

name: Azel
message: 「That's why I'm walking like this with the likes of you. Even though there's no meaning to it.」
Countless shooting stars streaked across the sky all at once, lending the night a faint brightness,
and Azel's profile was softly illuminated.
My heart skipped a beat.

name: Azel
message: 「Still, something like this isn't bad.」
Azel smiled. It was an innocent smile.

name: Azel
message: 「Just like you. Walking like this isn't bad either.」

name: Synn
message: 「With me?」

name: Azel
message: 「Who else is there?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」
"Not bad" is a pretty understated way to put it, but Azel looks like she's enjoying herself.
A wave of happiness wells up inside me.
Azel is having fun walking with me.

name: Azel
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just thinking what a nice night it is.」
Feeling a little embarrassed, I look up at the sky.
Shooting stars looking as though they might rain right down into my eyes.

name: Azel
message: 「...You're right.」

name: Azel
message: 「I wish we could stay like this forever--」
Her words suddenly cut off.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Gah... ugh...」
Azel was crouching down, clutching her chest.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm... fine...」
The paleness of her face, illuminated by the light of the shooting stars, wasn't just a trick of the light.

name: Synn
message: 「You're not fine! Besides, this isn't the first time you've gotten like this, Azel! Are you feeling sick somewhere?」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm fine.」
Brushing aside the hand I reached out, Azel staggered to her feet.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
Suddenly, the distance between us grew.

name: Azel
message: 「I see... The night will eventually dawn... The master is absolute... How careless of me to have forgotten.」
